content: Mumušâwe â jambuŋdâŋ
Petoro no Jesu Kristo ere aposolo jukopaczi Anutu bâwosâecfâc-ticne Ponto â Galatia â Kapadokia â Asia â Bitinia mâreŋko ocŋondeŋ jaba juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋere papia ši qâreŋkekopac.
Anutu Mamaczi maname fowecte rowosâec-ŋopawec ŋoŋe hâcne Mârozi maŋfuru bacŋopaocte â mume rereŋfâcne eniŋte Jesu Kristore soc ruambiŋ: Ŋoŋerao aki anonoc â wama fua bâbâriŋ fuahuc fozejec.
Sambaŋ merâfâc-nâŋec šâŋe rarac biaŋ irec šeriezo
Nâŋâc Anutu, Wofuŋ-nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere Mamac, e muteŋkenšepeneŋ. Eki Jesu Kristo hâmockonec faharewecte uruc jauŋ sâko-ticnere erâ, juju fârire mamanac junaŋte bâɋârec-nâpowec.
Sambâŋko merâfâc-ŋeŋic šašaŋke tâmiric â bie gufec tâmiric â hâmo qanšaraŋ tâmiric woŋec-ŋeŋic râekicne fokac, i juku rauckeniŋte iŋuc hâcne eŋarewec.
Ehuc Anutu tâpiri-ticnezi bâwâzâŋ-ŋopame mamanasiŋhec juhapie juku dameŋ tarame bâbâpiaŋ kâdoc bâmockekicne i fua tâcneocmu.
Ŋoŋe irec šeri ehuc juŋgopieŋ, â Anutuzi muŋareme fific guguriŋ faio ferâ šâic busâqocko juhuc sifu dameŋ bembeŋne macte jamaŋ kirâ jueŋgopieŋ.

Manaŋgopieŋ, goì i wiac šašaŋkene fuŋne-ticne šocko taniŋkeekac, ŋoŋe ine mamanasiŋ-ŋeŋic, wiac furi sâko jâmbâŋ, irec fârine fific guguriŋko fua taniŋkeme Jesu Kristo fifisi-ticnao ŋoŋere šeri bubiaŋ â mumuteŋ â eri qaraweŋ fuaocmu.

Ŋoŋe Jesu e hawari-ticne mi honembiŋzi sifu maŋŋeŋic qikiŋnecneeŋgopieŋ, erâ dameŋ šiŋucne wâc šâŋezi mi hohone sifu manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Ehuc šeri bubiaŋ fuŋmoc, ŋicmiczi mi mumufuane, manacneeŋgopieŋ.
Mamanasiŋ-ŋeŋicte fârine maŋ qâqâtâc-ŋeŋicte bâbâpiaŋ hâcne, maic-ŋopakacte šeri eŋgopieŋ.
Porofete findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ irec fârine fuawec
Bâbâpiaŋ i weniŋuc fuazokac, porofete jaŋe mârâc jaha iŋuc wiorâ gufu koparic ehuc jumbiŋ, ehuc ŋoŋerao aki anonoc fuaocte irec findaŋdâŋ muhuc jumbiŋ.
Kristo e šâic fâro manaku eri tatamac-ticne rorâ juocmu, irec dâŋ Mâro-ticnezi maŋjeŋicko râeme jaŋe dameŋ wezimucko â weniŋucnao Kristo iŋuc fuacnezokac muhuc wawariehuc jumbiŋ.

Jaŋe gie bambiŋ irec fârine jaŋacnao mâcne, ŋoŋerao fuaocte mukicne, i jaŋe mufua-jarekicne. Eme šâhec irec fârine fuame Tiri Mârozi sambâŋkonec waharâ mitiŋic neŋgoc ŋejareme Biŋebiaŋ muromackembiŋ jaŋe hâcne findaŋdâŋte fârine mujaŋgeŋke-ŋarembiŋ. Dâŋ irec šuhucne aŋelo jaŋe wâc mana šiguaniŋte buââkec jueŋgopieŋ.
Qâpuc hata râpecke sanaŋkezo
Irec ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋicte umbika jomarâ maŋsowa junšepieŋ, ehuc Jesu Kristo fua tâcnerâ aki anonoc bâfua-ŋareocmu, irec mamanac junšepieŋ.
Anuture mume rereŋfâc ŋoŋe mârâc jaha qâpuc-ŋeŋicko sasechec jujumbieŋ, ju ju sâc ijaha šiŋuczia mi junšepieŋ.
Tiri runezi hefârec-ŋopawec ere sâcko tiri jaha jufârenšepieŋ.
Dâŋ šiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “No tiri jukopacte ŋoŋe tiri jaha junšepieŋ.”
Wiac furi sâkozi kitâc-nâpowec
Ŋoŋe Mamac mucnehuc wâsickeeŋgopieŋ e ra rowec ware rowec mi ehuc juju bapa-nâŋecte sâcko dâŋnâŋec mutaraocmu” irec ŋoŋe mâreŋko jaba juhuc sâc e araŋ bacnehuc junšepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe šiŋuc sâcne manaeŋgopieŋ, kâcɋenefâc-ŋeŋic jaŋere sindaŋ hata âtehuc juhapie wiac sisirowenezi, goì siliwa wiaczi mi kitâc-ŋopawec.
Ŋoŋe Kristore soc furi Sâko izi kitâc-ŋopawec. E hâcne lama sahac fâsâc â wânâŋ tâmiric iŋucne juwec.
E mârâc jaha, mâreŋte hobeteŋne mi fuahame gie i mucnekicne fufua ine šâhec dameŋ tarazo ehame ŋoŋere erâ fuawec.
Erâ ŋoŋe Anuturao šuhuc-ŋopawec, Anutu hâmockonec bâɋârerâ eri tatamac hec neme huwec erao hâcne” eme irec mamanasiŋ â woworic-ŋeŋic Anuturao fokac.
Mitidâŋzi bâɋârec-nâpowec
Ŋoŋe dâŋfâri murâ rereŋ ekupie maŋ qâqâtâc-ŋeŋic ɋaɋackewec i ââgo fârihec eniŋte iŋuc fuawec” eme irec maŋzi jâmbâŋ šâšâfic ehuc junšepieŋ
Ŋoŋe fufua ɋâri i ukic sisirowenaonec mâcne, mi sisirowenaonec, Anuture dâŋ jujune â fofo sanaŋ, irecnec âkešurâ fuambiŋ.
Dâŋ šiŋuc hâcne fokac:

content.text: â šâŋe rarac biaŋ-jeŋic i šariŋ âri iŋucne.
Sopâc kecɋaŋzi ɋaŋaekac â ârinezi mârâŋkeekac.
Anuture dâŋzi ine fofo sanaŋ foocmu.”

content: Biŋedâŋ biaŋne ŋazakicne ši hâcne.
